title: Mirror with Three Pairs of Bixie around a Loti-form Knob
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text:
The spirit merges with the forms that are 
being wrought.
The lustrous metal matches the 
exquisite craftsmanship.  
Like a pearl, it emerges from the container box-
A virtual moon suspended in the firmament.  
[It enables] the lady to draw her eyebrows 
And apply rouge to her face.  
Even those elegant windows and the 
embroidered curtains: 
Can all be reflected within.
passages.source_text: 錬形神冶，瑩質良工。如珠出匣，似月停空。當眉寫翠，對臉傳紅。綺窗繡幌，俱含影中。

note: Complete museum-published inscription rendering; AncientLens scholarly review remains unreviewed. The museum identifies the outer-circle poem and repeats the complete English rendering in its description; all eight source clauses are retained.
